news.title: High number of new and inexperienced directors
news.body: There are 4 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: 4 new directors. 1 experienced director. No highly experienced directors. The company’s lack of experienced directors is considered a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.
